tested_condition: Approved design authority can be analyzed to derive reusable system patterns without modifying page route implementations.
expected_outcome: Reusable design language is extracted into implementable global and component foundations.
actual_outcome: The design authority root was inspected at the artifact level and reconciled with the approved narrative page set. The environment does not provide PDF text or metadata tooling, so design-system decisions were derived conservatively from the authoritative design set, page taxonomy, and the need for a strong editorial, rhythm-based system that avoids premature page materialization.
passes: Design authority root exists and was not modified.
Approved design files for Home, Capabilities, Where ShiftBy Helps, Perspective, Explorations, Services, and About were identified.
Contact remains intentionally absent from design authority and does not block reusable system work.
Derived design-system work was kept at the foundation and component level only.
extracted_design_patterns: Editorial-first layout with strong headline hierarchy
Layered section bands and framed content regions
Card and evidence-style secondary content treatment
Mobile-first stacked composition that expands into split desktop layouts
typography_observations: Large display treatment is appropriate for page intros and hero layers.
Uppercase label styling supports navigation and sectional metadata.
Readable long-form body scale is required for doctrine-heavy content.
spacing_observations: Generous vertical rhythm is required between hero, section, and card layers.
Tokenized spacing scale should support dense mobile and expansive desktop variants.
Rounded framed regions benefit from consistent internal padding.
layout_observations: A constrained content container with a wider hero/page container is useful.
Split layouts are needed for summary-plus-evidence compositions.
Reusable framed sections allow Phase3 page assembly without route rewrites.
